title: Illuminated Folio from a Gulistan (Rose Garden) of Sa'di (c. 1213–1291)
artist: style of Sultan Muhammad (Iranian); style of Sultan 'Ali al-Mashadi (Iranian, 1430–1520)
subject: Gold trees, birds and animals on a dark blue manuscript border surrounding Persian calligraphy.
creditLine: Gift of William Kelly Simpson in memory of his wife Marilyn M. Simpson and her grandparents Mr. and Mrs. John D. Rockefeller Jr.

title: Garden Scene with a Master Instructing a Student in a Pavilion
subject: Pale, finely drawn Safavid garden with pavilion, grand tree and seated figures; quiet parchment palette.
creditLine: Purchase from the J. H. Wade Fund

title: Royal Reception in a Landscape, left folio from the double frontispiece of a Shahnama (Book of Kings) of Firdausi (Persian, about 940–1019 or 1025)
subject: Colorful Timurid royal garden reception with flowers, carpets, attendants, gold sky and blue clouds. Includes a small guard driving visitors away, no injury or graphic violence.

title: Entertainment in a Garden, Folio from a Khamsa of Amir Khusrau Dihlavi, Matla al-Anvar
artist: Unidentified painter; manuscript text by Amir Khusrau Dihlavi
subject: A royal garden feast with a ruler in a tree platform, musicians, dancers, guests and a flowering tree.
creditLine: Cora Timken Burnett Collection of Persian Miniatures and Other Persian Art Objects, Bequest of Cora Timken Burnett, 1956
